headline: AFP says a cyberattack hit AFP Forum, the platform its clients use to download its content; the platform is still offline.
summary: New incident page. AFP's statement, carried in its dispatch (s001, via La DH) and in management's internal email quoted by Anadolu (s003, via Bernama) and Al Jazeera (s002), says the agency was hit by a cyberattack from 1:30 am Paris time on Nov 26, aimed at AFP Forum; the platform was isolated and stays unavailable until further notice; subscribers are offered fallback solutions; analysis is under way with outside experts and AFP has no information on who did it. AFP Forum's front page (s004) showed only a maintenance notice at 11:27 PM ET. Main answer Confirmed, filed under hack-stated; incident_type attack; service down, resting on c003. Size Large. afp.com refused access, so AFP's own site was not read. Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread; Reddit could not be read; no outlet reports a claim by any group. Privacy check done: no staff, reporters or contact details named.
author: Research agent
